add.k: The moon god, now acting through Blade
st: Khonshu, acting through Blade since losing his last avatar, appears at New Asgard's gate and talks Valkyrie into opening it.
Through Blade, Khonshu backs the last stand against the Queen of the Dead and shouts a warning in the battle where Blade falls.

files.notes: Says 'I am the Moon God, Khonshu' to Valkyrie in episode 3 (transcript marvel-zombies-2025 s01e03); speaks 'Behind you!' in episode 4. Only mentioned in episodes 1 and 2 (Blade: 'His avatar was lost in the plague. Now the deity acts through me'), so no steps there. No group is named on screen for him (the Ennead is never said here), so Independent.

add.k: A Mohawk who found paradise in Sky World
st: In season 2, Atahraks welcomes Kahhori to Sky World and teaches her its powers, then follows her home to fight the conquistadors.
In season 2, Strange Supreme holds Atahraks prisoner for the Forge until Kahhori catches the falling captives and portals them home.

files.notes: Says 'I am Atahraks' (transcript what-if-2021 s02e06); Kahhori says 'Atahraks?' in s02e09. He grew up near the lake ('Lotta people went missing in that lake when I was a kid'), so he takes the app's existing Mohawk group, as Kahhori and Wahta do; the transcript itself only shows Mohawk as a language tag.

add.k: A cellular biologist hiding Bruce Banner
st: In season 1, Dr. Ross, secretly hiding Bruce Banner, finds that Tony Stark was killed by a projectile, then watches Banner die.

files.notes: Natasha calls her 'Dr. Ross' twice and she cries 'Father!' at General Ross (transcript what-if-2021 s01e03); a version of a person the app names, so she goes by Betty Ross. The wiki places her at Culver University, but the dialogue never names the school and I could not confirm a sign, so Independent.

add.k: A senior Nova Corps officer on sealed Xandar
st: In season 2, Garthan Saal brushes Nebula off at Yondu's murder, then leaves her for dead once Yon-Rogg takes the shield codes.
In season 2, he stands with Nova Prime as she opens the shield for Ronan, and dies when Nebula's allies beat his men.

files.notes: Named in Nebula's narration ('Garthan Saal and his lackeys') and by the speaker tag GARTHAN (transcript what-if-2021 s02e01). He sides with Nova Prime against the rest of the Corps; kept as Nova Corps since the Corps is the group he serves on screen. The casino worker who kills him (Korg on the wiki) is never named in this episode, so no tie to Korg.

add.k: A dealer at Howard's casino on Xandar
st: In season 2, Groot, a dealer at Howard's casino, helps patch up Nebula and fights the Nova Corps beside her to stop Nova Prime.
In season 3, Groot is on Xandar with Nova Prime Nebula when a giant monster attacks, until Captain Carter's team slays it.

files.notes: Says 'I am Groot' (transcript what-if-2021 s02e01, s03e07). In s03e07 he only speaks right after Nova Prime on the comms; I could not see whether he still works at the casino, so the casino group is kept.

st: In season 1, J.A.R.V.I.S. helps Tony and Killmonger build the Liberator drones, then records Killmonger killing T'Challa and Rhodey.
In season 1, the U.S. Military puts J.A.R.V.I.S. at the controls of its drone army against Wakanda, until the Wakandans cut his link.

files.notes: Tony says 'Jarvis' several times and Shuri names 'the Jarvis AI' (transcript what-if-2021 s01e06); the app names the prime AI J.A.R.V.I.S. The U.S. Military stage follows Ross's line 'The U.S. Military is hereby seizing control of all Stark Industries assets.' The wiki says Shuri later recovers his files for Pepper; the dialogue only shows Pepper asking 'How did you get this?', so that is left out of the steps.

add.k: An Air Force colonel, Stark's military liaison
st: In season 1, Rhodey looks into Killmonger for Pepper, then goes to buy Klaue's vibranium, where Killmonger kills him and T'Challa.

files.notes: Pepper calls him 'Colonel Rhodes', Tony says 'We send Rhodey. He's U.S. Air Force, and he's the company's military liaison' (transcript what-if-2021 s01e06). A version of a person the app names, so he goes by James Rhodes.

add.k: The voice of Ta Lo's Elder Council
st: In season 2, Jiayi, speaking for Ta Lo's Elder Council, trains Hela to seek light, then warns her she must face Odin alone.

files.notes: Says 'I am Jiayi. I speak for the Elder Council of Ta Lo' and later 'The Ta Lo are guardians, not fighters' (transcript what-if-2021 s02e07). Group uses the app's existing name Ta Lo.

add.k: A gunslinger who knows where the Hood is headed
st: In season 3, John Walker brawls with Shang-Chi and Kate Bishop, then tells them the Hood is headed to Point Pegasus.

files.notes: Shang-Chi says 'John Walker' and later 'Walker's tip was good' (transcript what-if-2021 s03e06). A version of a person the app names. He sneers at the missing immigrants and only talks once beaten, so a Raft file; no group is named for him, so Independent.

st: In season 2, Luis shoots Kahhori into the Forbidden Lake, then is pulled in himself and lands in Sky World, where her power kills him.

files.notes: Gonzolo shouts 'Luis, come on!' as the lake pulls his men under (transcript what-if-2021 s02e06). Not the app's other Luis (Scott Lang's friend); named on screen, so he passes the name test. His Spanish lines are subtitled only in part. The wiki has him wearing Wahta's necklace, which I could not confirm, so it is left out.

st: In season 3, Monica scouts the Arctic with Sam, talks him into seeking Bruce Banner, and fights the Apex as part of the Mighty Avenger.

files.notes: Sam calls her 'Captain Rambeau' and 'Monica' (transcript what-if-2021 s03e01). A version of a person the app names.

st: In season 3, Marc warns that the last war killed the old Avengers, fights in the Mighty Avenger, and urges firing on Mega-Hulk.

files.notes: Neither 'Marc', 'Spector' nor 'Moon Knight' is said in the dialogue (only caption tags say [Spector]); he says 'Khonshu says light him up!' (transcript what-if-2021 s03e01). Under the owner's rule a version of a person the app names goes by that name, and the app's prime file is Marc Spector, so he is Marc Spector, with Moon Knight as the alias; the Mech Avengers file already calls him Marc.

add.k: An Avenger piloting one of the mechs
st: In season 3, Nakia spots the Arctic Gamma signature and fights the Apex in the Mighty Avenger, then stands down from Mega-Hulk.

files.notes: Her name is never said in the dialogue (caption tags only); she is a version of a person the app names, so no name test. The satellite line and 'It looks like we have a new Apex' are hers per the wiki and caption tags (transcript what-if-2021 s03e01).

st: In season 1, Coulson finds a strange hammer in New Mexico, sees Clint die in a locked cell, and mourns the fallen candidates with Fury.

files.notes: Fury and Natasha call him 'Coulson' throughout (transcript what-if-2021 s01e03). A version of a person the app names. The hammer is never named in the dialogue, so it stays 'a strange hammer'.

add.k: A park ranger first on the scene of the Stark attack
st: In season 3, Ranger Morales helps Bill Foster chase the Winter Soldier and the Red Guardian to Las Vegas, until the Red Room arrives.

files.notes: Says 'Ranger Morales, sir' and 'The National Park Service is a federal agency, sir' (transcript what-if-2021 s03e03).

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Khonshu lost his avatar in the plague and now acts through Blade, who calls him a friend of the night traveler. At New Asgard, Khonshu shows himself and gets Valkyrie to open the gate for Blade's group, and Blade answers for him that the last stand is a fight worth fighting.
stages.whoA: His avatar, a vampire hunter
stages.whoB: The moon god he serves as avatar

stages.title: Marvel Zombies
stages.text: Khonshu looms over New Asgard's gate and asks if the Asgardians no longer know his deity. Valkyrie greets him as an old friend she has not seen in years and lets his avatar's group inside, and they later fight side by side in the last stand.
stages.whoA: An old friend who rules New Asgard
stages.whoB: An old friend, the moon god

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Atahraks greets Kahhori when she falls into Sky World and teaches her to feel its spirit and use her new powers. When she goes back to fight the conquistadors, he first argues against war, then comes through the portal with the Sky Worlders to save her.
stages.whoA: The young woman he welcomes to Sky World
stages.whoB: The Sky Worlder who teaches her its ways

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Strange Supreme takes Atahraks from his world and holds him with the other prisoners he plans to feed to the Forge. Kahhori spots him in the riot and catches the falling captives, sending Atahraks home through her portal.
stages.whoA: The friend who frees him from Strange Supreme
stages.whoB: A friend Strange Supreme takes prisoner

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: After the Sky Worlders rout the conquistadors, Atahraks kneels beside Kahhori's sibling Wáhta. He tells Wáhta that the thunder beings are real and that Kahhori is the bravest of them all.
stages.whoA: Kahhori's sibling
stages.whoB: A Sky Worlder who fights to free his people

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Gonzolo's conquistadors break into Sky World and later hold Kahhori at sword point on the shore. Atahraks and the Sky Worlders charge out of the forest, knock Gonzolo down and drive his soldiers back.
stages.whoA: The conquistador who invades his people's land
stages.whoB: A Sky Worlder who charges his soldiers

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Strange Supreme seizes Atahraks as one of his universe killers and holds him prisoner to feed his world's rebirth. Atahraks falls toward the Forge until Kahhori saves him.
stages.whoA: The sorcerer who takes him prisoner
stages.whoB: A prisoner taken from Kahhori's world

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Natasha, framed for Tony Stark's murder, asks Dr. Ross to test the injector off S.H.I.E.L.D.'s radar, and Ross finds a tiny projectile was fired from the needle. Natasha then finds Bruce Banner hiding in her lab and pulls Ross to safety when the army attacks.
stages.whoA: The agent who brings her a murder weapon
stages.whoB: The scientist who tests the injector

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Dr. Ross hides Bruce Banner in her lab and denies seeing him when Natasha comes asking. When her father's troops surround them, Banner turns into the Hulk, and Ross watches him swell and die.
stages.whoA: The man she hides from S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Saal calls Nebula Black Order trash and orders Yondu's murder scene scrubbed. Later he beats her and calls her end of watch, then aims his gun at her when she storms Nova Prime's surrender, and her allies defeat his men.
stages.whoA: The corpsman he scorns and leaves for dead
stages.whoB: The officer who leaves her for dead

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Saal serves Nova Prime as she plots to hand Xandar to Ronan. She leaves him to finish Nebula, and when Nebula foils the plan, Nova Prime orders him to kill everyone.
stages.whoA: The leader whose betrayal he serves

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Saal works alongside Yon-Rogg in Nova Prime's plan to open the shield for Ronan. When Nebula's allies win, Yon-Rogg points to Saal as the bad guy before both are beaten.
stages.whoA: The Kree who shares the plot
stages.whoB: A Nova officer in the plot

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Howard leads his casino staff into Nova Corps headquarters to help Nebula. Saal opens fire on Howard's crew and loses.
stages.whoA: The casino owner whose crew beats him
stages.whoB: A crooked officer his crew takes down

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Groot deals at Howard's casino and plays rock, paper, scissors with the staff. When Howard gives the order to strap up, Groot arms himself and follows him into the fight for Xandar.
stages.whoA: His boss, the casino owner

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: When a battered Nebula stumbles into the casino, Groot helps stitch her up. He then fights the Nova Corps with her crew as she foils Nova Prime's surrender to Ronan.
stages.whoA: The corpsman he helps save Xandar
stages.whoB: A casino dealer in her crew

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Groot is on Xandar again when a giant monster attacks under Nova Prime Nebula's watch. Captain Carter's team slays it, and Nebula thanks them.
stages.whoA: Xandar's new Nova Prime

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Tony has J.A.R.V.I.S. pull Killmonger's thesis and order parts, and plans to let him pilot the Liberator drones. J.A.R.V.I.S. records the ambush at Klaue's yard, and Tony confronts Killmonger with it before he is killed.
stages.whoA: His creator

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: J.A.R.V.I.S. helps Killmonger build his drones and learns to fight with his moves. After recording him kill T'Challa and Rhodey, a drone run by J.A.R.V.I.S. attacks him, and Killmonger destroys it and wipes the AI clean.
stages.whoA: The killer he records

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Tony sends Rhodey to buy Klaue's vibranium as the company's military liaison, to give the deal diplomatic cover. Rhodey never comes back, and J.A.R.V.I.S. shows Tony how he died.
stages.whoA: His friend at Stark Industries

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: At Tony's party, Rhodey tells Pepper that Killmonger is a trained assassin. He asks what worries her beyond the killing, and she says she cannot tell what Killmonger wants.
stages.whoA: The executive who asks him to dig
stages.whoB: The colonel who digs into Killmonger

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Rhodey checks out Killmonger and calls on him over comms at Klaue's yard. Killmonger stuns him, tells him he wears his oppressors' uniform, and kills him to start a war.
stages.whoA: The soldier who kills him

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: T'Challa raids Klaue's yard to take the vibranium home, and Rhodey's bullets do nothing against his suit. Before they can talk, Killmonger stuns them both and kills them.
stages.whoA: The masked raider he fires on

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Jiayi tells the fallen Hela that darkness can only be fought with light and agrees to teach her Ta Lo's practice. Through breathing and paper folding she leads Hela to admit she wants freedom, and when Odin arrives she warns Hela she will walk that path alone.
stages.whoA: The Goddess of Death she trains

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Shang-Chi calls Walker out, and Walker and his men pick a fight that Shang-Chi and Kate win. Pressed about the Hood, Walker says the Hood is headed to Point Pegasus and will come for them in time.
stages.whoA: The wanderer who beats him for a tip
stages.whoB: A gunslinger he beats for a tip

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Shang-Chi asks Kate when she last missed her mark, and she answers with a demonstration on Walker's men. With Shang-Chi she beats the gang until Walker gives up the Hood's trail.
stages.whoA: The sharpshooter who beats his gang

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Luis chases the Mohawk children into the cave for Gonzolo and reports that they have found the Fountain of Youth. When the lake pulls the soldiers under, Gonzolo shouts for Luis to get out, but it takes him.
stages.whoA: His commander

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Luis shoots Kahhori as she fights his men, and she falls into the lake. He later attacks Sky World, where Kahhori stops his bullets in the air and the land itself kills him.
stages.whoA: The young woman he shoots

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Luis hunts Wáhta and Kahhori into the cave by the lake. After Kahhori falls, he brings Wáhta to Gonzolo as a captive.
stages.whoA: The child he takes captive

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Sam takes Monica to the Arctic, where they find the Apex commanding thousands of Gamma Beasts. She tells him that he and Bruce talking is all that stands between them and the end of the world, and he later repeats it back to her when he faces Mega-Hulk.
stages.whoA: The Captain America who leads her team
stages.whoB: A teammate who pushes him to Banner

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Monica has Barnes go behind Sam's back to find Bruce Banner. Bucky tracks Banner to an abandoned black site, and they later fight side by side in the Mighty Avenger.
stages.whoA: The teammate she sends after Banner
stages.whoB: The teammate who sends him after Banner

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Nakia's satellites find the Gamma signature that sends Monica and Sam to the Arctic. At the New York harbor they hold off the beasts together until Sam arrives with the Mighty Avenger.
stages.whoA: A teammate in the mechs

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Marc fights under Sam in the Mighty Avenger against the Apex. When Bruce becomes Mega-Hulk, Marc wants to light him up, but Sam orders the team to stand down.
stages.whoA: The Captain America who leads his team

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Nakia and Marc fight side by side in the Mighty Avenger, urging the team to hit the Apex harder. When she names Mega-Hulk as the new Apex, Marc answers that Khonshu says light him up.
stages.whoA: A teammate in the mechs

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Nakia reports the Gamma signature in the Arctic, and Sam heads there with Monica. She later fights the Apex in the Mighty Avenger and stands down when Sam calls off the attack on Mega-Hulk.
stages.whoA: The Captain America who leads her team
stages.whoB: A teammate who tracks the Gamma signal

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Coulson reports the hammer in New Mexico and the intruder at the site to Fury. He helps Fury see that the murders target the Avengers candidates, and at the end they stand over the five coffins together.
stages.whoA: His director

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Natasha, wanted for murder, calls Coulson for his password to the Avengers Initiative files. He refuses until she reminds him Clint was his friend too, then gives it up.
stages.whoA: A fellow agent wanted for murder
stages.whoB: The agent who gives her his password

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Coulson works the hammer site with Clint, who insists he never fired the arrow that killed the intruder. Coulson guards Clint's cell and watches him die there with no sign of a struggle.
stages.whoA: A friend and fellow agent
stages.whoB: A friend who guards his cell

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Ranger Morales briefs Bill Foster on the Stark attack and picks him up for the car chase, and she stays on the case after the crash. Together they follow a map page to Las Vegas, where he has her call SWAT to surround the super soldiers.
stages.whoA: The agent running the case

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Morales chases the Winter Soldier, and he punches through her car and forces her off the road. She trails him to Las Vegas, where the Red Room takes him back.
stages.whoA: The super soldier she chases

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Morales chases the Red Guardian and the Winter Soldier from the crash site to a Las Vegas casino. He slips away in the chaos when the Red Room arrives.
stages.whoA: The super soldier she chases
